source.author: verg
source.text: Non licuit thalami expertem sine crimine vitam degere, more ferae, tales nec tangere curas!
source.text_original: Non licuit thalami expertem sine crimine vitam / degere, more ferae, tales nec tangere curas!
source.text_english: It was not allowed to pass life without marriage, without blame, in the manner of a wild beast, nor to be touched by such cares!

reuse.text_english: It was not permitted to live a life without a bridal chamber, free from blame, like a beast, nor to touch such cares.
